text: S09 acceptance scenario is now public and green on both platforms. It assigns SPMG1, SPMG2, and FIR(2) to cells A/B/C through ModelBuildSpec.hrfByCell, asserts five event columns plus intercept, structural provenance, semantic canonical contrast, FIR omnibus df=2, and rank evidence. Manifest fit.structural-s09-heterogeneous-hrf.v1 identifies the exact solver-only reference layer and commands. S06/S13/S18 remain open; S09 is not an independent end-to-end design oracle.
